title: AREX-2：通过长时程反思任务提升自改进智能体
summary: AREX-2 提出通过长时程反思任务提升 LLM 智能体的自改进能力，即测试时迭代优化解的能力。研究从机器学习与算法编程任务合成长时程改进轨迹进行训练，在 MLE-bench Lite、Frontier-CS、BrowseComp、HLE、GAIA 等基准上取得显著成果，且随迭代轮次增加持续提升。
summary_en: AREX-2 advances self-improving LLM agents—the ability to iteratively refine solutions at test time—via reflection and long-horizon execution. Training on synthesized improvement trajectories from ML and algorithmic programming tasks, the Qwen3.8-27B-based agent scores 81.8 on MLE-bench Lite, 70.7 on Frontier-CS, and transfers to deep research (84.0 BrowseComp, 52.6 HLE, 92.2 GAIA, 93.8 DeepSearchQA), improving with more rounds.
